meta.title: BoxBox · Who wins on Sunday?
meta.description: Win and podium chances for the next F1 race from the starting grid, the circuit and the weather. An XGBoost model trained on real results since 2022.

header.theme: Switch between light and dark mode

intro.title: Who wins on Sunday?
intro.lede: Pick the circuit and the weather, set the grid, and the model works out every driver's chance of winning and of reaching the podium in the next race.

grid.title: Starting grid
grid.hint: Drag a driver to another slot, or tap two drivers to swap them.
grid.resetHint: Back to the starting order of the last race
grid.selected: Selected. Tap another driver to swap.

predict.stale: You changed the setup. Predict again to update.

board.title: Pit board
board.empty: Set up the race and press “Predict race”. The most likely podium shows up here.
board.limit: Heads-up: in the backtest the model's favourite won {model} of races, while “pole sitter wins” was right {baseline} of the time.

table.title: Predicted order
table.caption: Normalised over all 22 drivers: win chances add up to 100 % and podium chances to 300 %.

trust.title: How far to trust it
trust.intro: Walk-forward backtest: the model predicted {races} races from the last 3 seasons without having seen them, and was compared with a simple rule that only uses the grid.
trust.honest: The model ranks the whole field better (AUC and log loss), but when it has to name a single winner it is right less often than “pole sitter wins”. Read it as chances, not a sure bet.
trust.footer: Data to {dataTo} · {model} {version} · Results from Jolpica, weather from Open-Meteo. Independent project, not affiliated with Formula 1.

errors.offlineTitle: No signal from the pit wall
errors.offline: Could not reach the prediction API. Check that the backend is running and reload the page.
